Event definition: On the second day of Operation Epsom, after the leading tanks of the 11th Armoured Division have crossed the Odon, tanks of the brigade and of the 31st Tank Brigade, which have been supporting the VIII Corps infantry and feeling for the enemy on the eastern flank, are stationed for the night in positions to resist an attack from either flank (p. 280); the corps had been strengthened for the battle by the two brigades (p. 275). notes: Event date: 29 June 1944, evening (Ellis, vol. I, p. 283, the day that "broke bright and clear" on the 29th). Event definition: On 29 June the Germans counter-attack the western side of the Odon salient in about three-battalion strength astride the Noyers-Cheux road; after the attack is defeated, later in the evening a regiment of the brigade sweeps the country between Grainville and the Noyers road, where pockets of the enemy are still found (p. 283).
